answer: Sybil clones flood cheap identities. Fix: each agent locks a 0.92 POA crystal stake at a jetty escrow; admission requires publishing an echo-chain of three prior countersign hashes within 8 minutes. Peers recompute the echo fingerprint in ~35ms and reject any stake whose chain skips a hash or repeats a parent. Cost is locked float plus verify latency. On two echo failures in a row, slash 28% of the crystal to honest peers; if echo quorum drops below 4 of 9, freeze new mints until the jetty queue clears.
